author: centennial state news
title: Grand Junction announces start of 2026 Chipseal Program and new community survey
text:
The City of Grand Junction announced on June 10 the beginning of the 2026 Chipseal Program, highlighting its role in preserving city streets. The announcement also included updates on Community Recreation Center memberships, which are now available to residents.
According to the city, an upcoming community survey will provide residents with an opportunity to share feedback regarding city services, priorities, and future planning efforts. The survey aims to gather input that will inform decision-making for various municipal initiatives.
In addition to these main updates, the City encouraged residents to review the full update for more information about ongoing news, projects, events, and services throughout Grand Junction.
The annual Chipseal Program is part of regular maintenance work designed to extend the lifespan of local roadways. Memberships at the Community Recreation Center are intended to promote recreational opportunities within the community.
Residents can access further details and stay informed about additional developments by visiting official city communication channels.
